none: PAS BM-DE4475: Roman Coin: Denarius of Alexander Severus
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A plated contemporary copy and hybrid of a silver denarius of Severus Alexander dating to the period AD 228 to 235 (Reece period 11). P M TR P VII COS II P P reverse type depicting emperor sacrificing left over tripod and holding scroll. As Mint of Rome. cf. RIC IV, Pt II, p. 76, no. 81 for reverse. The obverse legend IMP SEV ALEXAND AVG only appears on later issues
